statement: Community controller-family descriptions name NFC/IR MCU output 0x11, input 0x31 and related subcommands, but they do not specify a complete verified Switch Pro Bluetooth MCU exchange, error handling or host acceptance. This feature must be explicitly restricted until Pro-specific evidence exists.
